functions.description: Parse base ClusterAgent log structure: timestamp, host, thread id, severity, component, and message body
Extract username referenced in authentication/configuration messages
Extract source IPv4 address from vCenter/peer-host/auth-source references
Extract destination master node IP/port (IPv4) or master IP (IPv6) references
Classify HA/FDM event action type based on message content

add.name: action
add.value: message.match(/Authentication failure/) ? 'auth_failure' : message.match(/authenticated successfully/) ? 'auth_success' : message.match(/isolation|Network partition/) ? 'isolation' : message.match(/heartbeat/i) ? 'heartbeat' : message.match(/elected|election/i) ? 'election' : message.match(/Configuration change|configuration update/i) ? 'config_change' : message.match(/Failed to establish|Reconnected/i) ? 'connection' : 'info'
